description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange w.e.f. 28.08.2017 to 03.09.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how foreign currency conversions will be handled for customs purposes. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements related to customs regulations.
